The focus of industry discussions is moving from whether models can run to whether capabilities can be continuously deployed, stably optimized, and truly integrated into the system's main path. Agent OS, system-native intelligent agents, cross-app execution, and on-device privacy protection—these once scattered technical keywords—are now converging toward a single direction: on-device agentification. At the conference, MediaTek integrated the Dimensity AI development suite, system-native agent capabilities, and gaming technology into a unified narrative. MediaTek empowers the 'agentified experience' with a full-stack, diverse technology and product portfolio covering smartphones, automotive, IoT, and AI infrastructure, leveraging ubiquitous powerful computing power combined with advanced cloud AI acceleration technology to open up pathways for global ecosystem partners—from creativity to large-scale implementation, from application value to commercial success."

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, Zaihe Truck announced it has completed a total of 1 billion yuan in financing. As a pioneering leader in the AI heavy truck sector, Zaihe Truck has garnered support from top VCs including BV Baidu Ventures, Suzhou Venture Capital, and Lushi Investment, and has established deep "investment + industry chain" partnerships with renowned industry players such as Horizon Robotics, Chuangyuan Group, and Wan'an Technology. The state has explicitly called for vigorously developing electric and hydrogen-powered heavy trucks, building zero-carbon transport corridors, and promoting the large-scale application of vehicle-road-cloud integrated intelligent transportation systems. New energy intelligent heavy trucks and autonomous driving are entering a strategic window of opportunity with policy, market, and capital alignment. In 2025, Zaihe Truck was recognized as a potential Chinese unicorn enterprise and a Jiangsu Province dual-innovation talent enterprise, and ranked among the top three new heavy truck players in delivery volume.

Además, ha establecido una profunda cooperación de "inversión + cadena industrial" con empresas reconocidas como Horizon Robotics, Chuangyuan Group y Wanan Technology. Asimismo, ha obtenido un apoyo financiero integral de los cinco grandes bancos estatales, incluidos el Banco Industrial y Comercial de China y el Banco de Construcción de China. De este modo, Zaihe Truck ha completado un círculo cerrado de estrategia de capital que integra "capital social, deuda e industria". Basándose en la comercialización de entregas a gran escala, Zaihe Truck avanza en el altamente diferenciado sector de los "camiones pesados con IA integrada en vehículo y nube".
